whatIs.title: What is it?
whatIs.text1: It's your photo studio… without the studio. Upload your image, choose a setting — minimalist, design, lifestyle, or inspired by your brand — and get a high-resolution render ready to publish in seconds.
whatIs.text2: No more spending three hours fixing lighting, white backgrounds and reflections.

whyAdopt.title: Why adopt it?
whyAdopt.benefit1: Save days of shooting: no need to rent a studio or wait for a photographer.
whyAdopt.benefit2: Reduce production costs: an image uses just a few credits, far less than a studio photo shoot.
whyAdopt.benefit3: Standardize your visuals: a consistent style for your entire catalog, effortlessly.

howToUse.title: How do I use it?
howToUse.step2: Choose a studio setting or lifestyle environment.
howToUse.step3: Let our AI balance the light, perspective and shadows.
howToUse.step4: Download your final image, ready to use.

quotes.quote1: Your photo studio, now in the cloud.
quotes.quote2: From concept to final render, in less than a minute.
quotes.quote3: Images worthy of a photographer, without a photographer.

whatIs.title: What is it?
whatIs.text1: It's where fashion meets machine. You choose the ideal profile (gender, body type, style, emotion), and the AI generates a model consistent with your image and your brand.
whatIs.text2: No more castings or endless retouching.

whyAdopt.title: Why adopt it?
whyAdopt.benefit1: Make it relatable: a face, a posture, a mood. Your products come to life.
whyAdopt.benefit2: Endless variations: change the model, look or setting in a few clicks.
whyAdopt.benefit3: Stay consistent: keep a uniform visual style across all your campaigns.

howToUse.title: How do I use it?
howToUse.step1: Choose your product or generated image.
howToUse.step2: Select the model type: age, origin, pose, clothing style.
howToUse.step3: Adjust the light and position, then let the AI harmonize everything.

quotes.quote1: Visuals full of life, without a human model.
quotes.quote2: Say goodbye to castings, hello to creativity.
quotes.quote3: The ideal model exists. It's waiting for your prompt.

motionStudio.title: Motion Studio
motionStudio.subtitle: Turn your images into animated videos.
motionStudio.conceptImageAlt: Illustrative image — product in a staged scene
motionStudio.workflowImageAlt: Illustration of the Motion Studio workflow

whatIs.title: What is it?
whatIs.text1: It's the logical next step: breathe life into your visuals. Motion Studio converts your product images into realistic, cinematic or advertising videos, ready for TikTok, Instagram or your site.
whatIs.text2: From static to dynamic, without a film shoot.

whyAdopt.title: Why adopt it?
whyAdopt.benefit1: Multiply formats: a single image becomes a video, an ad or a story.
whyAdopt.benefit2: Capture attention: motion stands out more than a still image in a feed.
whyAdopt.benefit3: Simplify production: no team, no camera, just an idea.

howToUse.title: How do I use it?
howToUse.step1: Import your image or a scene created in Glint Studio.
howToUse.step2: Describe the motion you want (tracking shot, rotation, slow motion…) and choose a length of 5 or 10 seconds.
howToUse.step3: Let the AI generate a smooth and realistic clip.
howToUse.step4: Download your MP4 video, ready for your campaigns.

quotes.quote2: From a simple photo to a video ad.
